post.summary: Enqueue a Data Subject Request export
post.description: Queues an export job for a user's data as part of GDPR/CCPA compliance. Returns immediately with job tracking info.

post.summary: Enqueue a Data Subject Request delete
post.description: Queues a deletion job for a user's data as part of GDPR/CCPA right-to-erasure compliance. Returns immediately with job tracking info.
Places a legal hold on a user's data, preventing deletion until the hold is cleared. Used for litigation or regulatory preservation.

Allows an authenticated but inactive user to redeem a valid invite code.

File an appeal against a moderation decision. Authenticated users with active

post.description: Submit a moderator review decision for an appealed content case. Requires moderator privileges.

post.summary: Cast a community vote on an appeal
post.description:
Authenticated community members may cast a weighted vote (`uphold` or `deny`) on
an open appeal. Duplicate votes are rejected. Vote eligibility and quorum rules
are enforced server-side.

400.description: Invalid vote value or duplicate vote

get.summary: Get the latest privacy request status
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's latest matching asynchronous privacy request.

post.description:
Records an export, account deletion, or rectification request and queues
it for durable processing. Acceptance does not mean processing is complete.

429.description: export_cooldown_active: export requests are limited to one request per authenticated user in 30 days.

get.description:
Streams the authenticated subject's unexpired completed export as a private JSON
attachment. The success payload is the export file itself, not an API envelope.
Access is recorded as the `privacy.export_accessed` activity event.

Cache-Control.description: Private export responses are never cacheable by shared intermediaries.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename for the requested export.

ETag.description: Object entity tag supplied by private export storage.

X-Content-SHA256.description: Hash recorded in the completed export manifest.

404.description: export_not_found: the request is not this subject's completed, unexpired export.

503.description: export_unavailable: private export storage cannot currently serve the manifest object.

200.description: Moderation decision applied. An associated appeal remains open until the governance process resolves it.

post.summary: Record a trained editorial appeal adjudication
post.description:
This never auto-resolves an appeal. The shared governance policy evaluates
the independently assigned reviewer quorum and then requires one trained
adjudicator for standard risk or two for high risk. The outcome is applied
only when the returned status is resolved.

200.description: Current governance evaluation and, only if resolved, the applied final outcome.

get.description: Editorial, administrator, and owner roles may list independent appeals awaiting adjudication. Only trained editorial adjudicators may record an adjudication.

200.description: Open appeals with a durable community outcome awaiting one or more independent adjudications.

cloudflareAccess.name: CF-Access-Jwt-Assertion
cloudflareAccess.description: Cloudflare Access JWT assertion required by the admin Worker.

error.description: Constant identifier for rate limit breaches

scope.description: Scope of the limit that triggered the breach

limit.description: Maximum requests permitted within the window

window_seconds.description: Window size for the limit in seconds

reason.description: Additional context for specialized scopes (e.g. auth backoff)

accessLabel.description: Manual Alpha entitlement label; no active payment system is implied.

maxCustomFeeds.description: Maximum custom feeds available to this tier.

newsBoardAccessLevel.description: Free receives preview; Premium and Black receive full access.

newsBoardPreview.description: Whether the tier can read the safe News Board preview.

postingRestricted.description: Whether normal posting is product-limited beyond abuse controls.

rewardLevelCap.description: Highest reputation reward level available to this tier.

rewardOptionsPerLevel.description: Reward options per reputation level; null means all eligible rewards.

declaredCreationMode.description: Required user authorship disclosure. Public responses use categorical labels only.

aiLabel.description: Required whenever content or media changes. Public responses use categorical labels only.

valid.description: True when the invite code is active and redeemable.

inviteCode.description: Returned exactly once when the invite is created.

ErrorResponse.description: Canonical error envelope returned by handler-based endpoints.

message.example: The request body is missing required field "text"

details.description: Optional structured details (e.g. field-level validation errors)

ValidationErrorResponse.description: 400 response with structured field-level validation failures.

ModerationFlagValidationError.description: Validation response returned by the moderation flag handler.

ForbiddenError.description: 403 – authenticated caller lacks required role or permission.

message.example: You do not have permission to perform this action

ModerationBlockedResponse.description: Returned when content is rejected by the moderation pipeline.

status.description: Content was rejected by automated moderation

moderationCategory.description: Primary moderation class that triggered the block

AcceptedResponse.description: Generic 202 acceptance body returned by ctx.accepted().

AppealCreatedResponse.description: 201 response after successfully filing a moderation appeal.

AppealVoteRequest.description: Payload for casting a community vote on an appeal.

AppealVoteResponse.description: Confirmation of a recorded appeal vote.

PrivacyRequestCreate.description: An asynchronous privacy request submitted by the authenticated subject.

PrivacyRequest.description: Current state of an asynchronous privacy request.

FeedPageEnvelope.description: Standard success envelope containing a paginated feed page.

FeedPageResponse.description: Paginated feed page data and metadata.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for fetching the next page; null when no further pages exist

applied.description: Applied ranking modifiers and personalization signals

RedeemInviteRequest.description: Request body for redeeming an invite code.

RedeemInviteResponse.description: Successful invite redemption – includes fresh token pair.

activated.description: True when account was newly activated by this redemption

ModerationAppealRequest.description: Request body for filing a moderation appeal.

caseId.description: Identifier of the moderation case being appealed

statement.description: User's statement explaining why the decision should be reversed
statement.example: I believe this content was flagged in error because...

ServiceUnavailableError.description: 503 – service temporarily unavailable (dependency outage, maintenance window, or upstream timeout).

message.example: Service temporarily unavailable. Please retry after the indicated delay.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Suggested number of seconds to wait before retrying

BadGatewayError.description: 502 – bad gateway (upstream service returned an invalid or unexpected response).

message.example: An upstream service returned an unexpected response. Please try again.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when exhausted.

DeclaredCreationMode.description: Public author disclosure. AI-generated public content is not accepted.

SafetyLimitError.description: Stable, neutral anti-abuse limit response. No user-supplied content or detector result is disclosed.

EmailVerificationResponse.description: Private verification result. The response contains no user or email identifier.

PrivacyExportDocument.description:
Private JSON attachment generated for the authenticated subject's completed export.
The exported record set is versioned and intentionally has no stable envelope.

AppealCreateRequest.description: The caller may appeal a resolved case for their post or comment, or an account case where the case content ID is the caller's user ID.

NewsBoardItem.description: The Worker retains a redundant legacy `published_at` field for compatibility; clients consume the canonical `publishedAt` field.

CommentCreateRequest.description:
The declaration is a deterministic public authorship disclosure. AI-generated
content is rejected. For ai_assisted, the normalized body must contain fewer
than 250 user-perceived Unicode characters (grapheme clusters).

CommentSubmission.description: A comment or reply is accepted for moderation and is not immediately public.

accountabilityIdentityDeclared.description: Whether a private accountability name is stored. This is not a verification claim and never discloses the name.

accountabilityName.description: Private encrypted accountability name. It is never returned by profile or activity APIs.

ReviewerQualificationState.description: Reviewer training is a distinct governance qualification; reputation level, including L5, is insufficient on its own.

limitParam.name: limit
limitParam.description: Maximum number of items to return per page

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor returned by the preceding page.

idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated replay key. Completed retries return the stored response.

requiredIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
requiredIdempotencyKey.description: Required replay key for an immutable reviewer vote.

XCorrelationID.description: Server-generated correlation identifier for distributed tracing. Include in support requests.

XRateLimitLimit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the enforced window

XRateLimitRemaining.description: Remaining requests before the limit is hit

XRateLimitReset.description: Unix epoch seconds when the current rate-limit window resets

BadRequest.description: The request could not be validated or a domain invariant prevented it.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication or required Cloudflare Access authorization failed.

NotFound.description: The requested resource is not available to the caller.
